trigger_conditions: Fabio Valentini uses the **Initial Volume Breakout (IVB)**—his term for the
Initial Balance—to determine the winner of the most important battle of the
day: the New York cash session opening [1, 2].
Fabio defines the IVB range using the first **30 minutes** of the New York
outcome: session (09:30 to 10:00 EST) [1, 3]. He uses a volume profile to identify the **Point of Control (POC)**—the price level within that 30-minute range where the most volume was transated [3, 4]. *   **The Breakout Rule:** The direction of the bias is established by which side of the 30-minute range is broken first.
